name: Forge
text:
Decision: We will build every new package, tab enrichment, and draft element as a **standalone, self-contained module** with a clear "Created by EXCAVA" label baked into its metadata.

Why: This keeps things simple and reusable. One module per task means no tangled dependencies, and the label makes ownership obvious to everyone—no hunting for credits. It also future-proofs things; if a module needs to move or change, it’s a clean cut.

Trade-off: We accept a bit more upfront work to split things cleanly. It might feel slower than dumping everything into one big file, but that mess would cost us later in confusion and rework.
